name: A coordinator role and personal-agent grant for approvals and the web merge slot
aliases: take and release the merge slot
summary: Coordinator roles and personal-agent grants supply reviews.approve and coordinate while the account holds them; worker credentials do not. Agents never approve their own party. Supported single-process live checks remain; inherited endpoint-binding and second-process faults are not repaired. GET merge-slot reads native holder/context. Acquire/release use coordinate and bound usr_/agent_ names. Force-release with expected_holder/reason and explicit create/repair need a signed-in owner or superuser, never an agent. One verified_web_authority helper checks exact project/capability against configured live state; ordinary host payloads/answers and independent_approval remain. No silent creation; missing/damaged/unread slots get recovery. Stable keys reconcile confirmed retries without releasing a later holder. Each confirmed write saves one deduplicated web audit with project/task/actor/before-after holder/opid before its HTTP receipt. Existing native/context/journal/service stores are reused. Page and named client ship together. No lifecycle writer, integration action, provenance mark, new store or switch.
